name: Spread Ample Characterizations
statement: Hereditary diameter optimality, the hereditary full-pair condition, and avoidance of every pc-minor-minimal non-spread ample class define the same class.
proof: The hereditary full-pair theorem proves the first two conditions equivalent. Pc-minor closure makes failure hereditary, so repeatedly taking a proper non-spread pc-minor terminates at a minimal obstruction and proves the avoidance formulation.
